headline: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland app and online banking stopped working for many customers on Friday morning; the bank has given no cause.
summary: New incident page. The Register (s001, 12:01 GMT) and The Independent (s002) report that Lloyds Bank customers could not log in, pay or check balances in the app and online banking on the morning of Nov 27; the Lloyds Banking Group spokesperson statement is quoted by The Register and London Loves Tech (s003). Bank of Scotland was hit too. No cause given; error messages spoke of technical problems. Downdetector figures (s003, s002) are Reported. Lloyds' own sites, including its service status page (s004), returned an error page to us, so the bank's own status could not be read. About line from Wikipedia (s005). Main answer Not established, filed under unclear. incident_type outage; service down on c001. Size Large.
